name: desktop
description: Let your agents see and use the apps on your Windows PC, through the 5dive desktop app. Off until you turn it on in the app; one tap on Stop interrupts it. Paying stops for your approval by default (the browser's policy: set careful and posting, sending and deleting stop too). What is on your screen is never logged.

verbs.name: desktop
verbs.summary: see and use apps on the owner's Windows PC
